title: Section comparison is natural under pro-etale test restriction
statement: Fix the internal module derived functors of [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], condensed coefficients [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], and maps sectionComparison, sectionsArrow and fibreMap of [def-sfb-closed-test-derived-exchange-maps] in the common universe [def-weil-size-convention]. For any scheme map f:X→U, weakly etale test b:W→U, weakly etale test b′:W′→U and arrow a:W′→W with a≫b=b′, TestNaturality Λ f a holds: sectionComparison followed by restriction on the fibre product equals restriction after Rf_* followed by sectionComparison, on every bounded-below derived input. No affineness of X or contractibility of the tests is required.

proof.text:
identify internal modules with modules over the section-ring sheaf and use
condensed localization to identify inverse image along b with slice restriction.
Choose a K-injective representative I. Exact inverse image makes f_*I K-injective;
slice restriction preserves K-injectivity. The direct-image identity (f_*I)(W)=I(X×_U W)
and unbounded sections localization identify both sides with the same section complex.
The right-derived composition comparison is normalized by this ordinary identity.
Under the induced derived adjunction, the unit-square-counit formula defining
sectionComparison is precisely that comparison. Thus its components are invertible.
For a map a of tests, both composites are the presheaf restriction on I, with the
canonical pullback composition identifications. This proves TestNaturality after Q.
Shifting I shifts these same comparisons degreewise with identical differential signs,
so the comparison commutes with the fixed termwise and K-injective shifts.
The argument permits arbitrary unbounded inputs, nonaffine sources and empty tests.

theorem proetale_section_localization
    {X U W : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ U) [WeaklyEtale b] :
    ∀ {W' : Scheme.{u}} (b' : W' ⟶ U) [WeaklyEtale b']
        (a : W' ⟶ W) (ha : a ≫ b = b'), TestNaturality Λ f a ha
